proved: The Rust-owned request targets exactly /v1/responses, uses bearer authentication, sends stream:true plus Accept:text/event-stream, forces store:false, and omits previous_response_id and prompt_cache_key.
The transport requires text/event-stream, enforces the shared 32 MiB aggregate ceiling, and remains inside the existing absolute request timeout and caller cancellation future.
A successful xAI response must carry x-zero-data-retention with the exact boolean text true or false; missing or malformed attestation fails before any event callback runs.
The incremental Responses decoder reports xAI provider identity and normalizes response.created, text deltas, final usage/status, sanitized errors/warnings, and [DONE].

Unsupported function/tool and reasoning event bodies are represented only by content-free event-type warnings; argument, secret, error-message, and research canaries never enter normalized events or the content-free run record.

The native task runtime accumulates a bounded xAI response, removes the cancellation registration, marks the record as streamed, and preserves true/false ZDR response-header attestation in the typed outcome and authoritative record.
The workspace remote-review routing selects native streaming for every built-in remote provider and never applies the returned review to the shared draft automatically.
notProved: A live xAI credential, endpoint response, model ID, rate limit, billing behavior, or provider-policy behavior.
Function/tool argument assembly, schema validation, execution, server-side tool behavior, or citation normalization.
Encrypted reasoning continuity, previous-response chaining, stateful storage, or WebSocket mode.
Retry, reconnect, duplicate-event, slow-consumer, or backpressure behavior.
Packaged native Send once dialog interaction or a shipped updater artifact containing this checkpoint.
Any model-quality, truth, consensus, or superiority property.
